purpose: Lead the image-editing team, ensure delivery and quality within the assigned domains, and deploy team capabilities effectively.

responsibilities.responsibility: Plan team capacity against productions, campaigns, urgent requests, and re-edits.
responsibilities.authority_notes: May obtain relevant production forecasts from Brand Management.
responsibilities.obligation_notes: Escalate material capacity gaps to the Head of Content.

responsibilities.responsibility: Monitor image-editing performance and quality indicators.
responsibilities.obligation_notes: Report recurring deviations to the Head of Content.

responsibilities.responsibility: Maintain and improve the image quality guideline.
responsibilities.authority_notes: Consult Brand Management before material changes.
responsibilities.obligation_notes: Material changes require approval by the Head of Content.

exclusions: Ownership of production-process optimization remains with the designated process role.
Disciplinary personnel decisions are not implied by this role profile.
assumptions: Approval and escalation thresholds must be confirmed by the organization.
